errorCodes.authTokenMissingAction: Configure an API key or complete OAuth login for the provider.
errorCodes.authModelNotResolvedAction: Set a default model or configure the requested model alias.
errorCodes.contextOverflowAction: Compact the conversation or retry with fewer tokens.
errorCodes.providerFilteredAction: Revise the prompt or model configuration to avoid provider safety filtering.
errorCodes.providerRateLimitAction: Retry after the provider rate limit resets.
errorCodes.providerAuthErrorAction: Check provider credentials and authentication configuration.
errorCodes.providerOverloadedAction: Retry after the provider recovers from overload.
errorCodes.providerNotFoundAction: Check the provider id or configure the provider first.

errorCodes.storageCorruptedAction: Inspect the backing store; the corrupted entry must be repaired or dropped.
errorCodes.storageLockedAction: Another process holds the store; close it or retry later.

errorCodes.wireCycleAction: An onChange handler re-dispatches endlessly; break the op cycle.
errorCodes.wireUnknownRecordAction: The record was written by a newer version; upgrade or drop it.

errorCodes.configPersistBlockedAction: Fix config.toml so it can be read, then run "/reload" before writing.
errorCodes.sessionNotFoundAction: Check the session id or start a new session.
errorCodes.sessionAlreadyExistsAction: Use a different session id or open the existing session.
errorCodes.sessionForkActiveTurn: Cannot fork session during active turn

errorCodes.sessionUndoUnavailableAction: Request fewer turns; some of the requested turns are no longer undoable.
errorCodes.sessionExportNotFoundAction: Check that the session has stored data before exporting.

errorCodes.sessionExportTooLarge: File is too large to export
errorCodes.sessionClosedAction: Start a new session to continue.
errorCodes.sessionPermissionModeInvalidAction: Use one of the supported permission modes: yolo, manual, or auto.
errorCodes.sessionPlanModeInvalidAction: Exit plan mode before entering it again.
errorCodes.sessionBusyAction: Wait for the current turn or compaction to finish, then retry.
errorCodes.agentAlreadyRunningAction: Wait for the agent to finish or stop it first.
errorCodes.agentNotASubagentAction: Run this operation on a subagent.
errorCodes.agentNotOwned: Agent is not owned by this session
errorCodes.agentNotOwnedAction: Use an agent created by the current session.
errorCodes.agentTypeNotAllowedAction: Use an agent type allowed by the current profile.
errorCodes.agentMaxTokensExceededAction: Raise the max_tokens limit or shorten the task.
errorCodes.turnAgentBusyAction: Wait for the current turn to finish, then retry.
errorCodes.modelNotConfiguredAction: Set a default model or configure one with "/model".
errorCodes.modelConfigInvalidAction: Check the model entry in config.toml.
errorCodes.profileThinkingAliasConflictAction: Set only one of thinkingEffort or thinkingLevel.
errorCodes.profileUnknownAction: Check the profile name or define it first.
errorCodes.profileAlreadyBoundAction: Start a new session to switch profiles.
errorCodes.profileNotBoundAction: Bind a profile to the agent first.
errorCodes.providerConnectionErrorAction: Check the network connection and retry.
errorCodes.skillNotFoundAction: Check the skill name or install the skill first.
errorCodes.skillParseFailedAction: Fix the skill file and retry.
errorCodes.skillNestedTooDeepAction: Reduce the nesting depth of skill invocations.
errorCodes.compactionFailedAction: Retry the compaction or start a new session.
errorCodes.taskLimitExceededAction: Wait for running tasks to finish or stop some of them.
errorCodes.mcpServerNotFoundAction: Check the server name or add it to the MCP configuration.
errorCodes.mcpServerDisabledAction: Enable the server in the MCP configuration.
errorCodes.mcpStartupFailedAction: Check the server command and its logs.
errorCodes.mcpToolNameCollisionAction: Rename the conflicting tool or disable one of the servers.
errorCodes.pluginNotFoundAction: Check the plugin name or install it first.
errorCodes.pluginLoadFailedAction: Check the plugin files and retry.
errorCodes.requestWorkDirRequiredAction: Provide a working directory for the request.
errorCodes.promptNotFoundAction: Check the prompt id or start a new prompt.
errorCodes.promptOptimizerDisabledAction: Turn on the prompt_optimizer experimental flag to use it.
errorCodes.promptOptimizerEmptyDraftAction: Provide a prompt draft to optimize.

errorCodes.specModeInvalidAction: Exit spec mode before entering it again.

errorCodes.fsIsDirectoryAction: Use a file path instead of a directory.

errorCodes.fsAlreadyExistsAction: Choose a different path or remove the existing entry.
errorCodes.fsTooManyResultsAction: Narrow the search pattern or path.

errorCodes.fsGitUnavailableAction: Install Git and make sure it is on PATH.

optionDescriptions.session: Resume a session. With ID: resume that session. Without ID: interactively pick.
optionDescriptions.continue: Continue the previous session for the working directory.
optionDescriptions.spec: Write a spec for the change before implementing it.
optionDescriptions.model: LLM model alias to use for this invocation. Defaults to default_model in config.toml.
optionDescriptions.prompt: Run one prompt non-interactively and print the response.
optionDescriptions.outputFormat: Output format for prompt mode. Defaults to text.
optionDescriptions.skillsDir: Load skills from this directory instead of auto-discovered user and project directories. Can be repeated.
optionDescriptions.addDir: Add an additional workspace directory for this session. Can be repeated.
optionDescriptions.agent: Agent profile to use for this invocation (v2 engine only). Custom profiles are discovered from agent directories or loaded via --agent-file.
optionDescriptions.agentFile: Load an agent definition from a Markdown file and select it (v2 engine only).
optionDescriptions.exportSessionId: Session id to export. Defaults to the most recent session.
optionDescriptions.forkDescription: Fork a session into a new session.
optionDescriptions.forkCwd: Working directory used to find the most recent session to fork. Defaults to the current directory.
optionDescriptions.forkSessionId: Session id to fork. Defaults to the most recent session.
optionDescriptions.exportNoIncludeGlobalLog: Skip bundling the active global diagnostic log (~/.kimi-code/logs/kimi-code.log, not rotated .1 files). By default the global log is included.
optionDescriptions.acpLogin: Run the device-code login flow then exit (entry point for ACP terminal-auth).
optionDescriptions.visPort: Port to bind. Default: auto-pick a free port.
optionDescriptions.visNoOpen: Do not open the browser automatically.
optionDescriptions.doctorConfigPath: Validate this file as config.toml instead of the default path.
optionDescriptions.doctorTuiPath: Validate this file as tui.toml instead of the default path.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionHost: Bind host. Omit for {{host}} (local); pass --host for {{lanHost}} (all interfaces), or --host <host> for a specific address. The bearer token is printed at startup.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowedHost: Extra Host header values to allow through the DNS-rebinding check. Repeatable or comma-separated; a leading dot matches a domain suffix (e.g. .example.com).
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionInsecureNoTls: Allow a non-loopback bind without a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. Defaults to true; only relevant for non-loopback binds.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowRemoteShutdown: On a non-loopback bind, keep POST /api/v1/shutdown enabled (default: disabled → 404).
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowRemoteTerminals: On a non-loopback bind, keep PTY /api/v1/terminals/* routes enabled (default: disabled → 404). Remote shell is high risk.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionDangerousBypassAuth: Disable bearer-token auth on every REST and WebSocket route, and advertise it via /api/v1/meta so the web UI connects without a token. Only use on a trusted network or behind your own authenticating proxy.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionLogLevel: Server log level: {{levels}}. Omit to keep logs off.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionDebugEndpoints: Mount /api/v1/debug/* routes for test introspection. OFF by default; production callers leave this unset.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionNoOpen: Do not open the web UI in the default browser.
optionDescriptions.providerApiKey: Registry API key. Falls back to KIMI_REGISTRY_API_KEY; omit both for public registries.
optionDescriptions.providerListJson: Emit the raw providers/models config as JSON.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogJson: Emit the matching catalog slice as JSON.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogApiKey: API key for the provider. Falls back to KIMI_REGISTRY_API_KEY.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogDefaultModel: Mark the imported model as default_model after import.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogBaseUrl: Override the catalog endpoint. Required when the catalog declares none (or an env placeholder).
optionDescriptions.upgradeYes: Skip the confirmation prompt and install the update directly.
optionDescriptions.updateDownloadManual: the stage answers an explicit user-initiated upgrade
optionDescriptions.acpRegion: Login region used together with --login: "mainland-cn" (kimi.com) or "global" (kimi.ai).
optionDescriptions.sessionListCwd: List sessions of this working directory. Defaults to the current directory.
optionDescriptions.sessionListJson: Emit the session summaries as JSON.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionWebTitle: Set a custom browser tab title for this web UI instance (default: "<workspace dir> | Kimi Code").
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionRemoteControl: Expose the web UI through Kimi Remote Control.
optionDescriptions.migrateRun: Run the migration non-interactively and print step-by-step logs. Migrates everything unless --config-only is also given.
optionDescriptions.migrateConfigOnly: With --run: migrate config, MCP servers, REPL history and skills, but skip chat sessions.

subagent_fork.title: Fork context for subagents

tool_select.title: Tool select (progressive tool disclosure)
tool_select.description: Keep MCP tool schemas out of the immutable top-level tools[]; the model loads them on demand via the select_tools tool. Only takes effect on models whose capability catalog declares dynamically loaded tools.
